description: This file defines a SequentialScheme class for color schemes, including methods for creating linear scales and retrieving color arrays, extending a base ColorScheme class.

classes.name: SequentialScheme
classes.description: A class representing a sequential color scheme with methods to generate scales and color arrays.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a SequentialScheme instance with configuration options, including whether the scheme is diverging.

methods.name: createLinearScale
methods.description: Creates a D3 linear scale with a domain and range based on the color scheme, optionally modifying the range to match the domain length.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Returns an array of colors from the scheme, interpolated to match the requested number of colors and extent.
